https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: PersistentVolumeClaimCondition contails details about state of pvc

lastProbeTime.description: Last time we probed the condition.

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: Unique, this should be a short, machine understandable string that gives the reason for condition's last transition. If it reports "ResizeStarted" that means the underlying persistent volume is being resized.

https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: Time is a wrapper around time.Time which supports correct marshaling to YAML and JSON.  Wrappers are provided for many of the factory methods that the time package offers.

schema.description: PersistentVolumeClaimStatus is the current status of a persistent volume claim.

accessModes.description: AccessModes contains the actual access modes the volume backing the PVC has. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes#access-modes-1

capacity.description: Represents the actual resources of the underlying volume.

conditions.description: Current Condition of persistent volume claim. If underlying persistent volume is being resized then the Condition will be set to 'ResizeStarted'.

phase.description: Phase represents the current phase of PersistentVolumeClaim.

description:
The persistent volume claim is currently in the **Bound** phase, offering a single access mode of **ReadWriteOnce**. It reports a storage capacity of **10 Gi**.

Two conditions are recorded for this claim. The first condition, of type **Bound**, has a status of **True**; it was last probed at **2023-09-15T10:20:30Z** and last transitioned at **2023-09-10T08:00:00Z**. The reason noted is **ClaimBound**, with the message “PVC bound to PersistentVolume”. The second condition, of type **ResizeStarted**, carries a status of **False**; the reason is **ResizePending**, and the message states “Resize of underlying volume is pending”.

conditions.message: Resize of underlying volume is pending
